Definition
[Strong double 2ε-horn and capped 2ε-horn] ↗ def:strong-epsilon-horn A strong double $2\epsilon $-horn is a component diffeomorphic to $S^2\times (0,1)$ consisting entirely of strong $2\epsilon $-necks, hence a $2\epsilon $-tube with two horn ends. A $C'$-capped $2\epsilon $-horn is the union of a $(C',2\epsilon )$-cap core and such a horn; it is an open $3$-ball or a punctured $\Ar P^3$.
